title: MCPL v0 event
description: The one envelope every UI event uses: product actions, metrics, traces and scripted (AI or lesson) events. An app event is emitted only after the action it names has succeeded on the server.

eventType.description: Dotted name. App events use <area>.<object>.<past-tense verb>, for example mail.message.sent.

resource.description: What the event is about, such as a domain or a mailbox.

payload.description: Never secrets: no passwords, keys or message bodies.
